neighbours.label: Reaching a numeric milestone: turning an age, passing a record ('turns 37 next April', 'passed Babe Ruth', 'his 3,000th hit'); plain statements without a milestone stay quiet
fire: My daughter turns 16 next month and wants a car.
He will be turning 60 in the spring of next year.
The striker passed Pele's record with his 78th goal.
She surpassed the old mark of 400 wins last night.
The town turns 200 at the end of next June.
By next May she will have reached 1,000 games.
The firm turns 50 next year and plans a party.
He broke the career record with his 3,000th hit.
quiet: My daughter is 16 and wants a car.
He is a retired teacher from the north of the city.
The striker scored a goal and thanked his coach.
She visited the old school where she learned to swim.
The town sits at the end of a long road.
By the lake she walked for hours with her dog.
The firm makes paper and plans a party.
He hit the ball over the fence.
